name: web-design-deep-build-better-glass-card-blue-ribbon-swirl
title: 'Design deep, build better, refine quicker' frosted-glass card over a glossy blue ribbon swirl
whatItIs: A glossy dark-blue swirling ribbon background with a frosted-glass rounded card holding a bold three-line headline, an italic subtitle 'Modern glassmorphism style', a small feature note, and footer labels for social media use and resolution, with an arrow and asterisk icon.
whatItMeans: Premium and current; the ribbon's glossy curves give a glass card a rich surface to refract, selling the effect itself as the product.
techniques: Set a frosted glass card against a glossy curved ribbon shape.
Label technical specs directly on a template asset.
Use an italic subtitle to soften a bold headline stack.

vocabulary.definition: A glossy curved band shape used as a dynamic background.
A translucent blurred panel mimicking textured glass.
